annotation.speech2: An oval loop through the points A on the right and B on the left. The upper half, labeled C 1, is drawn in blue and runs counterclockwise from A to B. The lower half, labeled C 2, is drawn in reddish purple and continues from B back to A, closing the loop.
The piece C 1 of the loop, running from A to B along the top.
The piece C 2 of the loop, running from B back to A along the bottom, so the loop is the union of C 1 and C 2.
